title: OpusPopuli SDLC — consuming-repo compliance profile
description: Declared by a consuming repo (conventionally at .claude/compliance-profile.yaml). Selects which control families apply; validate-profile.ts checks it against the registry. A control whose family is not declared here is inert for the repo.

repo.description: Human-readable name of the consuming repo, for evidence-pack headers.

families.description: Framework families that apply to this repo. Each must exist in the registry's profiles.families (enforced by validate-profile.ts).

applicability.description: Optional narrowing: the specific applicability contexts this repo operates in (e.g. ca-personal-information). Open vocabulary, mirroring the registry. When present, validate-profile.ts warns on values no active control uses. Omitted = all contexts of the declared families apply.
